Current Exhibition

Deities of Nepal III

Nepal Art Council / 3 September, 2026

Deities of Nepal III: Lore and Legends centres on legends, myths, and folk tales that keep our deities rooted in their cultural and communal contexts, rather than reducing them to mere décor.
Date: 17th September – 10th October, 2026
Time: 10:30 A.M – 5:30 P.M, Sunday to Saturday

The Nepal Art Council (NAC) was established in 1962 as a national institution, with the prime objective of promoting the art and artists of Nepal.
